name: Manor of Amnesia
source:
A man named Ken awakens in an elegant mansion with no memories of how he got there.

Supposedly, this mansion is his home, and the only other people with him in the mansion are a girl claiming to be his wife, and a young man working as a butler.
What secrets lie within his missing memories?
Will you pursue the answer to that mystery? Or simply live a happy life in this mansion?
This "world" shrouded in mystery is the stage.
Your own home, filled with memories that can either be remembered or forgotten.

[From [url=https://akimieroworks.wixsite.com/home/manor-of-amnesia]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫肯的男人在一座优雅的宅邸中醒来，但他不记得自己是如何到达那里的。

据说，这栋宅邸就是他的家，宅邸里只有一个自称是他妻子的女孩和一个当管家的年轻人。
他缺失的记忆中到底隐藏着什么秘密？
你会追寻这个谜团的答案吗？还是只是在这座豪宅里过着幸福的生活？
这个笼罩着神秘色彩的“世界”就是舞台。
你自己的家，充满了可以记住或遗忘的回忆。

[来自[url=https://akimieroworks.wixsite.com/home/manor-of-amnesia]官方网站[/url]]
